description: Manages personalized and organizational summaries of key entities like Partners, Contacts, and Interactions, providing quick access to relevant data and recent activities.

endpoints.name: GetMyPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves partners associated with the current user's dashboard, including those created or modified by the user, excluding drafts.
example_uses: Show me the partners I'm involved with on my dashboard.
List all partners I've recently worked on.
Get my dashboard's list of active partners.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to quickly view a list of partners relevant to the current user's activity, excluding draft records.

endpoints.name: GetMyContacts

example_uses: Show me the contacts I'm involved with on my dashboard.

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to quickly view a list of contacts relevant to the current user's activity, excluding draft records.

endpoints.name: GetMyDraftPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves draft partners associated with the current user's dashboard, specifically those created or modified by the user that are still in draft status.
example_uses: Show me the draft partners I'm working on.
List all partners I've started but not finalized.
Get my dashboard's list of pending partner records.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to view partners that the current user has started creating or modifying but have not yet been published or finalized.

endpoints.name: GetOrgUnitRecentUpdates
endpoints.description: Retrieves recent updates across all entity types (Partners, Contacts, Interactions) within the current user's organizational unit.
example_uses: Show me the latest activities in my organization.
What are the most recent changes across all records in my unit?
Get a summary of recent updates for my organizational dashboard.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to get a consolidated view of the most recent activities and updates across all relevant entities within the user's organizational unit.
